title: Twister on Tuesday
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie survive a Kansas tornado and learn 'try, try again'! / 杰克和安妮在堪萨斯躲过龙卷风，学到了「再试一次」！🌪️

q.en: Where does the magic tree house take Jack and Annie this time?
q.zh: 魔法树屋这次把杰克和安妮带到了哪里？

options.en: To a snowy battlefield by the Delaware River
options.zh: 特拉华河边冰天雪地的战场，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: A rain forest full of gorillas
To a prairie schoolhouse in Kansas
options.zh: 堪萨斯州大草原上的一间校舍

explain.en: The tree house landed near a creek in Kansas, where Jack and Annie found a dugout schoolhouse and met the teacher Miss Neely and her three students.
explain.zh: 树屋降落在堪萨斯州一条小溪边，杰克和安妮在那里找到了一间土屋校舍，认识了老师尼利小姐和她的三名学生。

q.en: Who is the young teacher at the dugout schoolhouse?
q.zh: 土屋学校里那位年轻的老师是谁？

options.en: A young woman named Miss Neely
options.zh: 一位名叫尼利小姐的年轻女子

options.en: A strict old man named Mr. Brown
options.zh: 一位名叫布朗先生的严厉老人

explain.en: The teacher was Miss Neely, who seemed only sixteen or seventeen years old. She was starting her very first day teaching in the dugout schoolhouse.
explain.zh: 老师是尼利小姐，她看起来只有十六七岁。那是她在土屋校舍教书的第一天。

q.en: What book does Jack read from during the first reading lesson?
q.zh: 在第一堂阅读课上，杰克读的是哪本书？

options.zh: 那本关于宾夕法尼亚州的书

explain.en: Miss Neely handed Jack the school's only reader, the McGuffey Reader, and asked him to read the first two lines of a poem: 'Twinkle, twinkle, little star.'
explain.zh: 尼利小姐把学校唯一的一本读物《麦古菲读本》交给杰克，让他朗读一首诗的前两行：「一闪一闪小星星」。

q.en: What food do Will and Kate share with Jack and Annie at lunch?
q.zh: 午饭时，威尔和凯特和杰克、安妮分享的食物是什么？

explain.en: Will opened a burlap sack and gave everyone a lumpy sweet potato. Kate and Will bit into theirs like apples, and Annie did too.
explain.zh: 威尔打开一个粗麻袋，给每人一个坑坑洼洼的红薯。凯特和威尔像啃苹果一样咬起来，安妮也照做了。

q.en: When loud thumping sounds hit the roof, what do Kate and Will think is happening?
q.zh: 当屋顶传来砰砰的撞击声时，凯特和威尔以为发生了什么？

explain.en: Kate and Will screamed 'Grasshopper attack!' because millions of grasshoppers had eaten their crops the spring before. But Miss Neely opened the door and said it was only hailstones.
explain.zh: 凯特和威尔尖叫「蝗虫来袭！」，因为去年春天曾有数百万只蝗虫吃光了他们的庄稼。但尼利小姐打开门说那只是冰雹。

q.en: How far did Will and Kate walk to get to the schoolhouse?
q.zh: 威尔和凯特走到学校要走多远？

explain.en: Will and Kate said they walked two miles to school. Jeb, the older boy, had walked five miles and had never been to school before.
explain.zh: 威尔和凯特说他们走两英里上学。而那个大男孩杰布走了五英里，并且之前从未上过学。

q.en: What terrible storm twists across the prairie while Jack and Annie are there?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在那儿时，席卷大草原的恐怖风暴是什么？

options.en: A blizzard with thunder and lightning
A tornado, also called a twister

explain.en: The greenish clouds dipped low and twisted into a funnel that tore across the prairie. Jack cried, 'It's a twister!' and they raced to save the schoolchildren.
explain.zh: 发绿的云层压低，拧成一个漏斗状的风柱横扫大草原。杰克喊道：「是龙卷风！」然后他们飞奔去救校舍里的孩子们。

q.en: Where do Jack and Annie hide the schoolchildren to escape the twister?
q.zh: 为了躲避龙卷风，杰克和安妮把学生们藏在了哪里？

options.en: In the storm cellar under the floor
options.zh: 地板下面的风暴地窖里

options.en: Inside a buried wooden wagon near the creek
options.zh: 小溪边一辆埋在地里的木制马车里
在一道高高的木栅栏后面

options.en: Up in the magic tree house

explain.en: Jack and Annie pulled up the rug, found the cellar door, and Jeb helped pull it open. Everyone climbed down the ladder into the storm cellar to stay safe.
explain.zh: 杰克和安妮掀开地毯，找到地窖门，杰布帮忙拉开它。大家顺着梯子爬进风暴地窖里躲避。

q.en: Who pulls open the storm-cellar door so everyone can get inside?
q.zh: 是谁拉开了地窖的门，让大家得以躲进去？

explain.en: When the wind was too strong for Jack and Annie to open the door, Jeb came over and pulled it open so they could all climb down into the cellar.
explain.zh: 当风太大、杰克和安妮拉不开门时，杰布过来帮忙把门拉开，大家才得以爬进地窖。

q.en: What writing is the 'something to learn' that Jack and Annie bring home?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮带回家的「要学习的东西」是哪段文字？

options.en: A story about last spring's grasshopper attack
options.zh: 一个关于去年春天蝗灾的故事

options.en: A list of rules for the one-room schoolhouse
A long letter home describing the twister that tore off the roof
options.zh: 一封描述掀走屋顶的龙卷风的家信，在很远很远的地方

options.en: The poem 'If at first you don't succeed, try, try again'
options.zh: 那首「如果一开始没有成功，就再试一次」的诗

explain.en: Jack copied a poem from the McGuffey Reader onto his slate. It said 'If at first you don't succeed, try, try again' — and Annie realized this was the 'something to learn.'
explain.zh: 杰克把《麦古菲读本》里的一首诗抄在石板上，诗里写着「如果一开始没有成功，就再试一次」——安妮意识到这就是「要学习的东西」。
